A. Watermelon
time limit per test1 second
memory limit per test64 megabytes

Given a watermelon weighing $$$w$$$ kilograms, decide whether you can split it into two positive even weights.

Input

Read an integer $$$w$$$, with $$$1 \le w \le 100$$$.

Output

Print YES if such a split exists, otherwise print NO.

Examples
Input
8
Output
YES
Input
3
Output
NO
Note

For weight 8, one possible split is 2 and 6.
